observations.type: source reports and contrary evidence retained together
observations.locator: p2 final paragraph, p3 second paragraph, p4 opening paragraph; p6 GroundStop section, visible OCR16-23; p8 federal communications paragraph, OCR24-37
values: information containment and restricted manifest access reported
parallel briefing of ATC coordinators and senior management/pager notification reported
no all-aircraft intrusion-warning discussion and no awareness of ATC request reported
individual-dispatcher ACARS messages and one all-captains message also reported
not on Washington Operations Center phone net and not in continuous Herndon contact; difficulties establishing bridge reported
observations.finding: These are distinct claims about message scope, recipients, authority and links. Selective internal information control does not itself establish a universal warning suppression policy or total failure to contact FAA.
observations.limits: Do not convert recollections into proof of delivery/non-delivery or intentional withholding. Actual policy/instruction, FI/SOCC logs, message contents and distribution, phone-net/bridge records and receipts are discriminating inputs. The memo also attributes confusion, routine nonresponses and a traditional hijack model; those are explanations offered by sources, not adjudicated causes.
